families.P1_exhaustive_a1: all ordered pairs (g_0,g_1) of Boolean functions on m data bits, m in {1,2,3}; F(x,y)=g_x(y), one fresh selector bit
families.P2_exhaustive_a2: all 4-tuples (g_00,g_01,g_10,g_11) of Boolean functions on m data bits, m in {1,2}; two fresh selector bits
families.P3_lowenergy_a1_m4: 20000 pseudo-random pairs on m=4 data bits with g_1 = g_0 flipped on k points, k uniform in {1,2,3}; seed 20261011
families.P4_bent_splice: g_0 = (-1)^{y1y2+y3y4+...} (inner-product bent) on m data bits, g_1 = g_0 with the all-zero point flipped; m in {2,4,6,8,10,12}; plus tensor squares (a=2) for m in {2,4}
families.P5_A017_independent: 300 pseudo-random (n,a,M,q) with n<=5, a<=3, q quadratic over F2; F=(-1)^q(x) y_(Mx); seed 7

arithmetic: integer Walsh-Hadamard transforms (exact); influences as exact integers over 4^n; entropies in float64 for P1-P3,P5 (evidence only, the inequality is proved analytically); P4 entropies as mpmath interval enclosures of exact rational masses (certified) plus 60-digit values; sympy series for the all-m asymptotic
escalation: none; no automatic increase of m or a
